title: Rest is part of getting stronger
headline: Rest is part of getting stronger
caption:
Stronger doesn't mean pushing harder every single day. 🤍

Your muscles build and repair in the quiet moments in between: a good night's sleep, a slow walk, a gentle stretch on the living room floor.

As the festive weeks fill up, it's tempting to either do everything or nothing. There's a kinder middle way: move well, then let your body recover.

That balance is what our classes are built around, from a strong reformer session to a slower Stretch class that leaves you feeling looser and calmer.

Find the class that suits your week through the link in our bio, at our Pilates studio in Clitheroe.
